prompt: Write `parseDuration(text)` in src/duration.mjs. The text has one to three parts `Nh`, `Nm`, and `Ns`, in this order, and a part may be left out. N is a whole number of 0 or more. One space may follow a part, as in `1h 30m`. The function returns the milliseconds. It throws a `RangeError` for any other text. That includes an empty text, a unit twice, a unit out of order, a fraction or a sign, a space at the start or end, and two spaces in a row.
